messages:
Anya Patel: Kicking off SI onboarding sprint for OptiSys — want to lock instructor roster, cert rubric, and when we push the marketplace entry. Draft below, please chime in.
Matt Chen: Sandbox access for OptiSys engineers — do we have a token flow documented? I can grant once we confirm scopes.
Jasper Reed: I can lead instructor sessions week of 4/11 — prefer hands-on labs + live Q&A.
Lee - OptiSys: Thanks Jasper. Our engineers prefer 2hr lab blocks, timezone PST. Also need a pre-recorded intro they can watch.
Sana (Enablement): Re: cert rubric: propose 3 tiers (Foundations, Integration, Advanced deploy). Quick pass/fail checklist + 2 sample prompts per tier. I can draft by EOD tomorrow.
Anya Patel: Nice — draft schedule: ```
Mon 4/10: Instructor prep + dry run
Tue 4/11: Foundations (live lab 2h) + office hours
Wed 4/12: Integration (live lab 2h) + CI/CD pattern deep-dive
Thu 4/13: Advanced deploy (live lab 2h) + security/harden session
Fri 4/14: Certification assessments + feedback session
```
Anya Patel: Marketplace timing: want listing live same week as Foundations but behind embargo until customer announcement. Need marketing copy & listing assets by 4/5.
Matt Chen: Sandbox token flow: use the partner API key with role=si_sandbox. I'll add scope list here: `read-models, invoke-dedicated, logs:read`. Want me to open a PR for the onboarding script?
Jasper Reed: Yes – PR for lab infra + terraform module would be great. Keep modules minimal so OptiSys can apply to their infra.
Lee - OptiSys: We will supply logo + short blurb. Also request a private runbook for our SOC team.
Sana (Enablement): For assessments, recommend 30min practical task + 15min oral. Pass requires 80% on practical and confidence in deploy steps.
Anya Patel: Action items: 1) Sana to draft rubric & assessment by 4/1 2) Matt to add sandbox scopes + PR by 3/30 3) Jasper to create lab repo skeleton by 4/3 4) Marketing to get assets from Lee by 4/5 5) PartnerOpsBot to open ticket for embargoed announcement and track approvals.
PartnerOpsBot: Ticket created: #P-4521 — "OptiSys SI Onboarding + Marketplace Listing" assigned to partnerships-marketing. ETA: 2024-04-05.
Matt Chen: Quick note — for private runs, OptiSys will need KMS integration checklist. I'll add to lab README.
Lee - OptiSys: Confirmed on KMS. Also: can Redwood provide a short sample SLA we can reference for internal signoff?
Anya Patel: Yes, I'll pull the SLA template from legal and drop in the ticket.
Sana (Enablement): One more ask — want a short "trainer cheat sheet" with common troubleshooting steps (latency, OOM, tokenization). I'll draft with Jasper.
Jasper Reed: I'll add sample eval prompts and golden outputs to the repo.
Lee - OptiSys: Sounds good. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Anya Patel: Great momentum. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and link to the draft lab repo once Jasper creates it.
Matt Chen: ping me when PR is up, I'll review infra bits.
PartnerOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 3 days before 2024-04-05 to partners-marketing channel.
